MMCD: Initialism of multimedia compact disc, a proposed storage medium eventually superseded by DVD.
MMORPG: Initialism of massively multiplayer online role-playing game.
MMPI: Initialism of Minnesota Multiphasic Personality Inventory.
MMR: The station code of Manmad Junction railway station in India.
MMRVACCINE: A combination vaccine against measles, mumps, and rubella.
MMX: Initialism of Matrix Math eXtensions, an extension to the x86 CPU instruction set architecture.
